t: Tracer 'Pro Series' precision construction pencil with replacement lead set and holster. Made from high-quality aluminium to withstand the wear and tear of construction sites, with a holster grip for increased control when working, for a more accurate mark. Ideal for applications such as marking ceramics, plastic, wood and metal work surfaces. Precision marking pencil also features an anti-roll design. Supplied with 24 extra-long, durable, replacement graphite precision leads (1.3 x 110mm) stored in an anti-snap lead dispenser, and site holster which can be attached to clothing or belt for easy access at any time.
